description: Source code for the FramePartsCollector class, which is a test utility for collecting and verifying HTTP/2 frame parts in unit tests.

classes.name: FramePartsCollector
classes.description: A test utility class for collecting and verifying HTTP/2 frame parts during testing.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the collector's state, clearing collected frames and resetting the current frame.

methods.name: frame
methods.description: Returns the collected frame at index n, or the current frame if n equals the number of collected frames.

methods.name: ExpectFrameHeader
methods.description: Sets an expected frame header for verification during tests.

methods.name: TestExpectedHeader
methods.description: Verifies that the provided header matches the expected header.

methods.name: StartFrame
methods.description: Begins collecting a new frame with the given header.

methods.name: StartAndEndFrame
methods.description: Starts and immediately ends a frame collection with the given header.

methods.name: CurrentFrame
methods.description: Returns the current frame being collected.

methods.name: FrameError
methods.description: Handles a frame error, creating a frame if necessary and verifying headers.
